email.subject: Maiden Flight
email.body:
Congratulations!
That sort of software isn't found just anywhere.
You should try something a little more interesting - if Viper had the sort of thing he's known for getting lying around, you should have everything you need to get into something more secure. How about the computer next to you, running the Glove Slap Demo? See if you can get in and open the CD tray.
Remember, any non-basic programs you get need a port number to run - like this:
>SSHCrack 21 ^filename ^portnumber
Just find a port you want to crack and run it on that.
Make sure you look over and see if it worked.
Good luck!
--Bit 0
